units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.label: Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: 1. A closed electronic auction shall be conducted in the procedure established by Article 75(1)–(6) of this Federal Law and this Article.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: 2. A participant whom the procurement commission has decided to provide with procurement documentation may submit an application under this Federal Law. It must contain the information and documents specified in Article 43(1) of this Federal Law, point 1, subpoints “м”–“п”, and points 2 and 5.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: 3. Participants that submitted applications may participate in the procedure for submitting offers of the contract price or the total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law) by submitting price offers reducing the initial (maximum) contract price or initial total of unit prices (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law). The procedure shall take place two hours after the application deadline, in the manner established by Article 49(3) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: 4. No later than one hour after the price-offer procedure ends, the specialized electronic platform operator shall:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: 1) rank each application in ascending order of the contract price or total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law) offered by its applicant, except in the case provided for in Article 49(3)(9) of this Federal Law, where applications of participants that submitted offers after the offer specified in the first subparagraph of Article 49(3)(9) of this Federal Law shall be ranked in descending order of the contract price or total of unit prices (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law). If several participants submit identical price offers, the application of the participant that offered earlier shall receive the lower rank number. For applications submitted without price offers, the application received earlier than the other such applications shall receive the lower rank number;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: 2) prepare a record of price offers containing:
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: а) the date and the starting and ending times of the price-offer procedure;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 4 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: б) the lowest price offer, or the highest price offer in the case provided for in Article 49(3)(9) of this Federal Law, submitted by each participant, indicating its application identification number, the time the offer was submitted, and the dates and times of submission of applications from participants that did not submit price offers;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 4 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: в) the ranks assigned to applications under point 1 of this paragraph;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 2 Part 4 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: 3) send the contracting authority the record provided for in point 2 of this paragraph, the applications submitted, and the information and documents specified in Article 43(6)(2) of this Federal Law concerning the participants that submitted them;
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: 4) notify each participant that submitted an application of its own lowest price offer and of the lowest offer submitted during the price-offer procedure, without identifying the participant that submitted that offer.
units.label: Point 4 Part 4 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: 5. No later than five working days from the day following the application deadline, but no later than the date for determining supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results set in the procurement documentation:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: 1) members of the procurement commission:
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: а) examine the applications received and the information and documents sent by the specialized electronic platform operator under paragraph 4(3) of this Article, and decide whether an application complies with the procurement documentation or must be rejected in the cases specified in Article 75(10)(2)–(7) of this Federal Law, or because the information and documents specified in paragraph 2 of this Article were not provided or do not comply with the procurement documentation;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 5 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: б) on the basis of the information in the record provided for in paragraph 4(2) of this Article and the results of examination of applications, information and documents under subpoint “а” of this point, rank each application found to comply with the procurement documentation in ascending order of its applicant’s lowest price offer, except in the case provided for in Article 49(3)(9) of this Federal Law, where applications of participants that submitted offers after the offer specified in the first subparagraph of Article 49(3)(9) of this Federal Law shall be ranked in descending order of their price offers, taking account of regulatory legal acts adopted under Article 14 of this Federal Law. The application of the winner of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection shall be ranked first;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 5 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: 2) the contracting authority shall use the specialized electronic platform to prepare the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results and, after the procurement commission members sign it with enhanced electronic signatures, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf and:
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: а) notify each participant that submitted an application, providing the information specified in paragraph 6(2) and (3) of this Article concerning its application;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 5 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: б) post the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results in the unified information system without publishing it on the official website.
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 5 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: 6. The record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results must contain:
units.label: Part 6 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: 1) the date on which supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results were determined; the information specified in Article 43(1)(1), subpoints “а” and “е”, of this Federal Law and entry numbers in the unified register of procurement participants for participants that submitted applications; and the identification numbers of those applications;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: 2) information on the decision that an application complies with the procurement documentation or is rejected, with reasons, specifying the provisions of this Federal Law and the procurement documentation with which it fails to comply, and the provisions of the application that do not comply with the procurement documentation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: 3) the ranks assigned under paragraph 5(1)(б) of this Article;
units.label: Point 3 Part 6 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: 4) information on conclusion of a contract at a price increased under Articles 28 and 29 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 4 Part 6 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: 5) information on the decision of each procurement commission member participating in examination of the applications concerning each application;
units.label: Point 5 Part 6 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: 6) information that the supplier (contractor, service provider) selection has been declared unsuccessful in the cases provided for in Article 77(1) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 6 Part 6 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: 7. A participant may ask the contracting authority for clarification of the results of examination of its application in the procedure provided for in Article 75(12) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: 8. A contract following a closed electronic auction shall be concluded in the procedure established by Article 75(13) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 76. Conduct of a closed electronic auction
units.text: 9. If a closed electronic auction is declared unsuccessful in the cases provided for in Article 77(1) of this Federal Law, it shall be conducted subject to the specific rules established by Article 77(3) and (4) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 76

units.locator: Article 77. Declaring a closed competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: Article 77. Declaring a closed competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.label: Art. 77

units.locator: Article 77. Declaring a closed competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 1. A closed competitive procurement method shall be declared unsuccessful in the following cases:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 77

units.locator: Article 77. Declaring a closed competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 1) the cases provided for in Article 52(1)(1)–(6) of this Federal Law. The provisions of those points relating to the procurement notice shall apply to the procurement documentation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 77

units.locator: Article 77. Declaring a closed competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 2) no requests for procurement documentation have been submitted by the end of the period for such requests provided for by this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 77

units.locator: Article 77. Declaring a closed competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 3) the procurement commission has decided under this Federal Law to refuse to provide procurement documentation to all participants that requested it.
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 77

units.locator: Article 77. Declaring a closed competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 2. In the cases provided for in Article 52(1)(1) and (2) of this Federal Law, a closed tender or closed electronic tender shall be conducted in the procedure established by this Federal Law, subject to the following specific rules:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 77

units.locator: Article 77. Declaring a closed competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 1) the evaluations specified in Article 73(10)(1)(б) and Article 75(9)(1)(б) of this Federal Law shall not be carried out;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 77

units.locator: Article 77. Declaring a closed competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 2) the contract with the participant that submitted an application meeting the procurement documentation requirements shall be concluded under Article 93(1)(24) of this Federal Law in the procedure established by this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 77

units.locator: Article 77. Declaring a closed competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 3. If a closed auction or closed electronic auction is declared unsuccessful in the cases provided for in Article 52(1)(1) and (2) of this Federal Law, the contract with the participant that submitted an application meeting the procurement documentation requirements shall be concluded under Article 93(1)(24) of this Federal Law in the procedure established by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 77

units.locator: Article 77. Declaring a closed competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 4. If a closed competitive procurement method is declared unsuccessful in the cases provided for in Article 52(1)(3)–(6) of this Federal Law or paragraph 1, point 2 or 3, of this Article, the contracting authority may conduct a new procurement under this Federal Law or procure from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) under Article 93(1)(24) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 77

units.text: § 6. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.label: § 6. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.label: Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 1. The contracting authority may procure from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) in the following cases:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 1) procurement of goods, works or services falling within the activities of natural monopoly entities under Federal Law No. 147-FZ of 17 August 1995 “On Natural Monopolies”, and services of the central securities depositary;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 2) procurement of goods, works or services from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) designated by a decree or executive order of the President of the Russian Federation or, in cases established by presidential instructions, from a supplier (contractor, service provider) designated by a resolution or executive order of the Government of the Russian Federation. Such legal acts shall specify the subject matter of the contract, its maximum duration, the sole supplier’s obligation to perform its contractual obligations personally or its ability to engage subcontractors or co-providers, and the required proportion of its contractual obligations to be performed personally. They may also require the contracting authority to demand contract performance security and provide for conclusion of the contract without using the unified information system. For procurement supporting the activities of the President of the Russian Federation, the presidential decree or executive order may provide that information required by this Federal Law and prepared and posted during that procurement is not to be published on the official website. The procedure for preparing drafts of those legal acts and instructions and the list of accompanying documents, including the justification of the contract price provided for in Article 22 of this Federal Law, shall be determined by a regulatory legal act of the President of the Russian Federation. This point does not apply to procurement of goods, works or services for municipal needs;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 3) performance of mobilization preparedness work in the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 4) procurement of goods, works or services for an amount not exceeding six hundred thousand roubles, or electronic procurement of goods for the amount provided for in paragraph 12 of this Article. The annual procurement volume under this point must not exceed two million roubles, or must not exceed ten per cent of the contracting authority’s total annual procurement volume and must not exceed fifty million roubles. Those annual limits do not apply to procurement by contracting authorities to meet the municipal needs of rural settlements or directly support the everyday life of the population in rural localities. For contracting authorities operating in a foreign State, procurement under this point is not subject to the limit setting a contract price of no more than six hundred thousand roubles. For a federal executive body procuring to meet the federal needs of State bodies established to support the activities of the President and Government of the Russian Federation, the annual limits under this point shall be calculated separately for that federal executive body and each such State body. Electronic procurement of goods under paragraph 12 of this Article shall not count towards the annual procurement volume permitted under this point;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 5) procurement of goods, works or services by a State or municipal cultural institution whose statutory objectives are the preservation, use and promotion of cultural heritage sites, or another State or municipal institution (zoo, planetarium, culture and recreation park, nature reserve, botanical garden, national park, nature park, landscape park, theatre, concert organization, television and radio broadcasting institution, circus, museum, house of culture, palace of culture, house or centre of folk creativity, house or centre of crafts, club, library or archive), a State or municipal educational organization, a State or municipal scientific organization, an organization for orphans and children without parental care in which such children are placed under supervision, or a physical culture and sports organization, for an amount not exceeding six hundred thousand roubles, or electronic procurement of goods for the amount provided for in paragraph 12 of this Article. The annual procurement volume under this point must not exceed five million roubles, or must not exceed fifty per cent of the contracting authority’s total annual procurement volume and must not exceed thirty million roubles. Electronic procurement of goods under paragraph 12 of this Article shall not count towards the annual procurement volume permitted under this point;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 5.1)–5.2) Not applicable under Federal Law No. 46-FZ of 08.03.2022; repealed by Federal Law No. 318-FZ of 08.08.2024;
